narrative.overview:
Fitter looks like race day among friends: vibrant, social, eye-catching, yet legible at a glance. The signature is the bib: a Tangerine band across the top, a monumental Bungee rank numeral, and a dashed tear-off tab carrying the one fact that matters next ("8.2 km to catch Sam"). Standing reads in seconds, on a phone after a workout or on a desktop.

Energy comes from type scale, bold flat colour and 2px Black Cherry outlines, never from texture or ornament. The ground is plain white so bibs, numerals and the two pops carry the screen. Black Cherry does the emphasis work a shadow or a heavier weight would do elsewhere. The theme is light only.

The Bib Stack (your bib in front, friends ahead and behind peeking) is the composition of the campaign detail surface; the Start List (one outlined sheet per race state, a fixed number / race / gap column grid, a tear-off footer) is the composition of the campaigns list. The bib anatomy, palette, type pairing and outline language are the global system. Campaign detail, the campaigns list, campaign create and join, and goals run on it; goals are flat bibs in a grid, and every goal form (join, "Add a goal", create's last step, the goals editor) is the same Goal Builder. The login page has not been migrated and still runs the legacy scaffold tokens and classes in `app/ui/src/style.css` (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--border`, `--text`, `--accent`, `.container`, `.card`, `.btn`, `.field`, `.muted`, `.progress-bar`); they are pending migration, not part of this system.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, Black Cherry ink and outlines, Tangerine and Cool Blue as flat pops.
Bib anatomy: band, monumental numeral, dashed tear-off tab; the start-list sheet reuses band and tear-off.
Bungee capitals for numerals, titles and labels; Hanken Grotesk for names and reading.
Flat surfaces defined by 2px outlines; one hard offset under the bib in focus.
Tabular figures everywhere a number appears.

rules.name: The Tangerine Is a Fill Rule
rules.body: Tangerine never sets text on white (3.1:1 fails AA), and white never sits on Tangerine. Text on Tangerine is Black Cherry (5.0:1). Tangerine may appear as a fill or as a 3px-or-heavier indicator stroke (active underline, your chart line), never as type.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: The palette carries no green in any role, including success and finished states. Finishing is shown in Cool Blue.

rules.name: The Strava Orange Is Strava's Rule
rules.body: `#fc4c02` appears only inside Strava's official "Connect with Strava" button and "Powered by Strava" mark. Tangerine stays visibly distinct from it.

rules.name: The Names Stay Human Rule
rules.body: Bungee is capitals only, so people's names, activity titles and anything user-written are set in Hanken Grotesk. Campaign titles are the one user-written string set in Bungee, as headline and bib band text; in start-list rows the race name is Hanken Grotesk 700, clamped to two lines.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) so values align down lists and across bibs.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the bib in focus gets the hard offset. Nothing else casts a shadow: preview bibs, empty-state bibs and start-list sheets sit flat. The 1px inset that thickens an invalid input's outline is a stroke, not a shadow.

dos: Do put the next gap on the bib's tear-off tab ("8.2 km to catch Sam").
Do set every number in tabular figures.
Do give every swipe interaction a visible button equivalent ("Ahead" / "Behind").
Do show "Powered by Strava" on every screen that displays Strava data.
Do mark "you" with Tangerine, consistently, on every surface: your band, your rank chip, your chart line.
Do outline bibs, sheets, chips, pills, inputs and notices in 2px Black Cherry, and focus with a 3px Black Cherry ring at 2px offset.
Do make a whole bib or start-list row clickable with a stretched link on its name, keeping nested controls above it.
Do word lower-is-better comparisons as "or faster" / "or slower", never "at most" a pace.
Do drop trailing zeros in values: "536 km" not "536.0 km", "2h" not "2h 0m".
donts: Don't set text in Tangerine on white, or white text on Tangerine.
Don't set people's names, activity titles or other user-written reading text in Bungee.
Don't introduce green, or Strava orange `#fc4c02`, into Fitter's own UI.
Don't drift into a dark neon fitness-tracker look or a generic white-card dashboard.
Don't add texture, gradients or soft shadows. Depth is outline plus the single front-bib offset.
Don't build new surfaces on the legacy scaffold tokens (`--accent`, `--bg`, `.card`, `.btn`).
